ValidationRule.description: If a quote on an open opportunity is marked as "Primary" and was created prior to Aug 14th, 2023 then the opportunity cannot be moved to "Closed/Won".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "Closed Won"), SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.CreatedDate < DATETIMEVALUE("2023-08-14 00:00:00") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please create a new quote and mark it as primary
